endorsements.name: Aiganysh Aidarbekova
endorsements.label: Introduction to Open Source Investigations
endorsements.description: Everyday an enormous amount of content is uploaded on the internet. Some of them like Google Map's satellite imagery, an Instagram post, or a random website can be the key to journalistic investigations from identifying neonazi criminals to tracking the use of chemical weapons to environmental research. In this session you will learn the basics of open source investigations, practical tools, methods and case studies from Bellingcat's experience. ABSTRACT
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2022
